summary: Plan routes, measure transport costs and strengthen safety controls with practical case exercises. Explore the course and review the outline.
lede: Transport management training helps coordinators, fleet supervisors and logistics analysts plan freight movement and monitor service, cost and safety. You will map transport processes with the SCOR Model, compare route and fleet options using cost and capacity measures, and assess risks while preparing performance reviews and an operational action plan; digital transport systems and GPS telematics are introduced as visibility tools, not configured in a lab.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who plan, execute, measure or govern freight and road transport activity, including those who need clearer operational evidence for service, cost and safety decisions.
modules: SCOR Model and Transport Process Scope
Transport KPI Reviews and Action Plans
prerequisites: No prior transport-management qualification is required. Familiarity with transport or logistics workflows is useful; no coding is required.
